items.title: Vibecheck – merge gate that checks you understand your AI-written code
items.raw_excerpt: Good evening folks, I built Github merge gate which that checks whether developers understand their own code when they create a PR. I kept getting sent PRs to review where it was obvious the author had pasted the ticket into an LLM and called it a day. It's self-hosted (so you can use it in your enterprise environments or privately) It is BYOK (Anthropic) obviously. I have two demos in the pull requests here: https://github.com/bhurghundii/vibecheck.dev/pulls - you can see what Vibecheck does (it blocks a PR for clearly showing no attempt vs a PR which gets it right) I would love feedback, especially from anyone dealing with a similar problem. I do use it for my own projects a lot so expect improvements.

items.title: 从 Agent 到 Loop：AI 正如何重构软件工程？｜QCon 上海 2026 即将开幕
items.raw_excerpt: 2026 年，AI 正在发生一个值得关注的变化。过去，我们更多讨论的是“模型能做什么”：代码能不能写、图片能不能生成、复杂问题能不能回答。而今天，当 AI 开始真正参与工作，软件工程面对的问题也随之发生变化，它面对的就不再只是一个模型调用问题，而是会进一步触及研发、数据、基础设施、质量、运维乃至组织协作的整个链条。这些也是今年 QCon 全球软件开发大会·2026（上海站）重点关注的方向。

items.title: Simulating student learning for better AI tutoring
items.raw_excerpt: StudentSim is a research system for evaluating and improving AI tutoring tools before they are tested with learners. It models how individuals may engage with tutors, giving feedback to improve tutor performance across subjects like chess, writing, and mathematics. The post Simulating student learning for better AI tutoring appeared first on Microsoft Research .
